cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Drop the demand to question our delivery driver. The missing-parcel claim goes through this form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your form requires a photo of the parcel I haven't received.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Use a photo of your empty doorstep. That's the delivery location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand in it holding today's newspaper?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beside the doormat. Put me under 'supporting evidence,' and leave the driver off your witness list.

mechanism: A copies a raffle number as claim entry and covers by helping B satisfy the official form while dropping the demand for a driver interview.
confusable: D180 substitutes the official process for a special request; D176 obtains an exception to that process.
comparison: Missing-parcel evidence compromise versus donor recognition without queue privilege.
seedUse: Keep B requested support photo as a cooperative cost A accepts to preserve the process.
